paper.title: Many-Body Quantum States with Exact Conservation of Non-Abelian and Lattice Symmetries through Variational Monte Carlo

results.system_description: Heisenberg, 8 × 8 · J = 1 · periodic · Sz = 0. H = J sum_<ij> S_i · S_j; spin-1/2 operators S = sigma/2; J = 1; no constant shift
results.variant: SU(2)-equivariant tree network with lattice symmetries
results.source_location: Appendix A, Table "Results for 8x8 lattice for various J2/J1" (tab:results8x8), row "ClebschTree (Ours)", column J2/J1 = 0
results.eligibility_evidence: Total variational energy of the SU(2)-equivariant ClebschTree state estimated by Markov-chain Monte Carlo (appendix Optimization details); the other rows of the table are quoted from other works.
results.notes: Total energy of the 8 x 8 lattice with periodic boundaries (divide by 64 for the energy per site), spin-1/2 operators, J1 = 1 (Sec. J1-J2 model). The state is an exact SU(2) singlet (S = 0, hence Sz = 0) with lattice symmetries. The error is printed as +-.
